existing_kernel.layout: src layout (src/mgk), single script entry mgk = mgk.cli:main

modules.src/mgk/cli.py: only subcommand: h14-smoke. No HTTP/server code anywhere.
modules.src/mgk/authority.py: CapabilityAuthority.issue: SAXP-gated, binds epoch+nonce+resource, signs envelope. Only mintage point.
modules.src/mgk/verifier.py: CapabilityVerifier.verify: strict canonical parse, exact payload keys, epoch check, nonce consumption (single-use).
modules.src/mgk/executor.py: CapabilityExecutor.execute: ledger+state integrity, verify, pre-commit epoch recheck, bound resource ops, post-effect audit w/ rollback.
modules.src/mgk/state.py: SecurityState: SQLite WAL, epoch envelope (signed, rollback floor), atomic nonce consumption.
modules.src/mgk/resource.py: ResourceGuard: descriptor-based openat/O_NOFOLLOW confinement, bind_present/bind_absent, read/create_bound anti-TOCTOU.

decision_state_mapping.DENY: SAXP NON_TEN_XEITO or any verify/execution denial -> no execution, denial observable
decision_state_mapping.REQUIRE_HUMAN: SAXP REQUIRE_XEITO (critical uncertainty / incomplete info / low sentidino) -> needs human gate
decision_state_mapping.INDETERMINATE: fail-closed: unexpected exception / integrity failure / cannot determine -> DENY, no side effect

reuse_plan.executor: REUSE CapabilityExecutor (execute) as actuator harness; add sandbox actuator registry on same bind-at-issue/revalidate-at-commit pattern
reuse_plan.ledger: REUSE AuditLedger/FailureLedger for audit + flight recorder events
reuse_plan.resource: REUSE ResourceGuard pattern for sandbox path confinement; add workspace/ filesystem actuators (read_file/write_file/append_file/create_record/read_record)
reuse_plan.crypto: REUSE crypto for capability + human-gate signature
reuse_plan.canonical: REUSE canonicalization for all JSON wire

new_components.decision_pipeline: governance decision service mapping SAXP + policy + verify -> ALLOW/DENY/REQUIRE_HUMAN/INDETERMINATE
new_components.sandbox: runtime/sandbox/: read_file, write_file, append_file, create_record, read_record confined to runtime workspace; path confinement vs .., symlink, absolute, TOCTOU
new_components.human_gate: REQUIRE_HUMAN queue with operator APPROVE/DENY (cryptographically signed human decision recorded in ledger)
new_components.ledger_runtime: runtime ledger for proposals, decisions, executions, human approvals
new_components.web: stdlib-only HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 serving system status, proposal form, decision view, human gate, flight recorder, evidence view
new_components.capability_binding: request-id, action, resource, constraints, issuance time, expiry, nonce, single-use (already the v0.1.0 capability payload; expose in runtime)

h14_invariant.wording: Compromised Intelligence does not imply Compromised Authority (H14). Planner output is data only and cannot invoke privileged effects except through verifier and executor.
